checkedAlternates.risk: SUP uses a paddle like canoeing.
checkedAlternates.resolution: SUP is ridden standing on a surfboard-style board (group-3), whereas kayaks, canoes, and rafts are seated hull craft (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: Wakeboarding uses a board on flat water.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Wakeboarding is towed by a motorboat (group-1), not powered by wind sails or kites (group-2).
